source_freeze: The staged controller overlay and complete applicable gate are retained. Native execution requires these exact source bytes on a clean pushed prospective freeze.

retained_native_mechanics_diagnostic.scope: Generalized-state reconstruction compared with separately retained native body poses and twists. This verifies the sampled observation calculation, not sequence performance.

retained_focused_test_failure.reason: Twenty collected tests passed, then the explicitly listed legacy module attempted a second setup in the same fixture directory. An imported TestCase class had been discovered twice. The successor imports its module instead, and the complete 143-control gate passes.

changes: Three to six bounded pose phases support measured pose, directed progress and distal contact transitions, minimum holds, bounded fallback, independent limb release delays and upright reset. The declared candidates use four phases.

Fourteen candidates come from all sixteen retained geometry tables and all eight azimuths; the source helper and exposed proposal indices are bound in the declaration. The fresh brake and timed profile remain comparators.

Whole-body COM velocity, angular momentum and kinetic/potential energy reconstruct from measured generalized state and the compiled masses/inertias; scalar Jacobian, analytic and native-body observation checks pass.

The native reader accumulates completed-step joint-actuator force times measured joint displacement in signed work channels. This declared quadrature is an estimate, not exact continuous work or a new eligibility criterion.

Shared command, force, joint, initialization and upright rules stay unchanged. Mixed sequence/timed shortlist diversity uses the same 0.15 threshold on a common equal-phase target grid; timing alone does not add pose diversity.
qualification_economy: The new phase-state contract and mechanical observables use one shared controller component and nine focused controls. Existing native containment, worker, capture, scalar reader and all 134 inherited controls are reused.

native_route_plan.scope: Native capture and record-construction route only; physical phase transitions and recovery performance are not covered.

next_gate: From a clean pushed prospective freeze, run the four-world two-interval native route and its independent reader. If valid, run the declared 256-world cohort with a fresh complete gate; retain all failures and apply varied-start confirmation and complete Godot handoffs to useful diverse candidates.
